comments.befrank: Won at Newmarket on reappearance then ran well in AW event; still favourably treated
comments.cogitate: Justified favouritism at Salisbury last month, posting a career-best performance
comments.crackinggold: Too free over 1m2f last time; now 0-5 on turf and peak form remains on AW
comments.greatacclaim: All wins at 1m but showed signs of a return to form in 7f contest most recently
comments.hickory: Won the Victoria Cup on stable debut; disappointing favourite at Newbury last time
comments.physique: Mostly encouraging form for new yard, notably solid second at Newmarket; commands respect
comments.qazaq: Lost his unbeaten record in latest AW start but this drop back to 7f may prove beneficial
comments.rockwalk: Seemed unsuited by the drop back to 7f this month on British debut
comments.royalvelvet: Record is 5-14; belatedly returns to 7f, over which she is 2-4; remains of interest
comments.tennesseegold: Steadily progressive last term; met traffic issues and never figured on reappearance
comments.twotribes: Consistent this term; ran creditably upped to 7f most recently; unexposed at the trip

comments.gaietymusical: Failed to transfer her AW form back to turf last time; something to prove
comments.littlekeilee: Half-length second in both starts for new yard, latest over C&D last Saturday; big player
comments.mandana: Has form figures of 122 since wearing a hood; solid chance in the retained headgear
comments.orangesky: May well show progress with Newcastle reappearance under her belt; one to consider
comments.sahana: Scored at Yarmouth on handicap/seasonal debut; the type to improve further; respected
comments.salveelectra: Form of Brighton win has been boosted by the runnner-up since; open to further improvement

verdict.comment: Penzance is not passed over lightly but ASHARIBA could be ready to go in again following her satisfactory reappearance.

comments.ashariba: Ran respectably when reappearing at Epsom three weeks ago and may resume her progress
comments.borgi: Has a run under his belt now but underperformed all four times he tried this trip in 2023
comments.fantasybeliever: Off since January; last summer he returned from a longer break to win three in a row
comments.hosannapower: Eased right down at Ayr five weeks ago as if something amiss; major chance on best form
comments.penzance: March win off this mark; should be much more potent back on AW after three runs on turf
comments.postileo: Did not shine last year for E Mullins; heavily beaten at 100-1 in hot AW handicap in April
comments.romieu: 11-day break was blamed for poor show one month ago; bred to stay at least 1m2f; AW debut
comments.royalapproval: Inconsistent overall and cut no ice last three starts; both wins were C&D; cheekpieces now
comments.sealegend: Usually in the money here; reportedly bled from the nose when tailed off three weeks ago
comments.stormcatcher: Rather struggling for form since March 2024 but he's not entirely dismissed back here
comments.wadacregomez: 5-9 record at Chelmsford and 2nd there last week; more opposable here and at this level

verdict.comment: The return to Newcastle could prompt an improved performance from DC COGENT on his second handicap start and he is the pick.

comments.annterry: Promise in 2yo campaign but well beaten on this month's handicap and seasonal debut
comments.bonniesboy: 0-8 but best RPR came on sole visit to Newcastle; not ruled out now back here
comments.capesovereign: Below par at York a fortnight ago but running well in defeat otherwise this season
comments.commanderatkinson: Has dropped down the weights but made it 0-9 when well beaten on stable debut at Thirsk
comments.dccogent: C&D maiden winner who could have more to offer now back on AW; on the shortlist
comments.hundredcaps: Won on reappearance at Beverley and things didn't go his way at Chester subsequently
comments.imnext: Mid-division in 0-90 at York last time and might not be far away now back down in grade
comments.invincibleannice: Well handicapped on best 2yo form but she's struggled on her three starts this season
comments.macedonian: 6f Polytrack winner for the Crisfords; new trainer is a dab hand with sprinters
comments.nordicgames: Won at Southwell on second handicap start and he's bred to do better still
comments.ziggystriton: Runner-up on two of his three starts and he's in calculations on handicap debut

races.raceComment: dccogent is marginally preferred with a score of 50.0%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and more progressive and more reliable profile over invincibleannice. Won 1 of last 4 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style. Key attributes include improving, though unfavorable draw need consideration.

comments.calcuttadream: Six-time AW winner who is on a handy mark and not discounted now back on AW
comments.cloudfree: Has dropped down the weights but well beaten on his last four outings
comments.coramento: C&D win in March and has continued in good form; this lightly raced 4yo has strong claims
comments.crocodileriver: Lightly raced 3yo; down in the weights but tailed off on both runs this season
comments.crownthorpe: Step back in right direction when fifth at Hamilton and he's not ruled out each-way
comments.encircle: Promising debut in January 2024 but unable to reproduce that form on her four starts since
comments.fireeyes: Modest strike-rate but runner-up the last twice and could be bang there once more
comments.greenlightforgo: His mark continues to fall but for good reason and he's now 0-11
comments.herkeios: 0-12 but placed a few times earlier this year; each-way possible now back down in trip
comments.heycrackers: Hasn't shown enough in his three handicaps to suggest he's the one to be on today
comments.hurricanebea: Well beaten on first three starts and same story when 33-1 for handicap debut in April
comments.martinsbrig: Flopped at Carlisle last time but this 3-time C&D winner could bounce back with bold bid
comments.myhoneyb: Went close off 9lb higher last June but unable to get competitive since
comments.popfavorite: Seven-time C&D winner, the latest in April, and race wasn't run to suit here last time

comments.missapres: Fair run both starts, latterly over 5f which looked to catch her out; return to 6f a plus
comments.missmambo: 6-1, ran well when a closing fourth on debut; stall 14 tricky but respected on turf debut

comments.runamara: 80-1 and beaten over 15l at Windsor on debut; most probably one for further down the line

verdict.comment: The most solid one here is KYBER CRYSTAL, with Jack Of Clubs taken to bounce back to form and give her most to do.

comments.agnesgrey: Beat only one home on reappearance; others preferred, even though Hollie Doyle is booked
comments.carltonandco: Running respectably this year but this might be on the short side
comments.hardnut: Well held in five runs following 50-1 Musselburgh win last summer; off five months
comments.jackofclubs: Pulled too hard on reappearance; back on a winning mark and placed both visits here
comments.kybercrystal: 5f winner in April; creditable third over C&D latest and has to be high on shortlist
comments.marisangel: Has yet to fire this year but this does represent a drop in grade
comments.northerner: Well held at Redcar last time, taking her record to 0-11
comments.pinpoint: Stamina possibly stretched over 7f on Saturday but still hard to be confident; visor added
comments.startling: Best form on AW but bit too soon to suggest she won't prove effective on turf

races.raceComment: kybercrystal is marginally preferred with a score of 55.3%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more progressive and more reliable profile over jackofclubs. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include improving, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.roachpower: Has shown he can make an impact from reduced mark on last two outings; rain would help
